en: Sepia-toned street scene labeled "Elsterwerda — Markt". It shows the market square of a small European town with cobblestone streets and late 19th–early 20th century townhouses. A corner building with a pointed tower stands prominently; shop signs on the ground floors advertise goods such as textiles and alcoholic beverages. A few pedestrians are visible in the square and along the street.
